facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Focus: Climate / hardware / food / web3 / emerging tech
facts_raw.Guaranteed Capital: Program-specific; not universally guaranteed across all Brinc programs
facts_raw.Funding / Support: Example current Climate Tech model: US$100K upfront investment from funding partner; Brinc programs vary by vertical/partner.
facts_raw.Funding Trigger: After shortlist/investment-partner approval; disbursement typically during or shortly after program
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: Program-specific. Climate Tech example: US$35K program fee due only after investment is fully disbursed + advisory share agreement; valuation typically US$2M–10M post-money.
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Varies by vertical; typically early-stage startup with program-specific technology/market fit and capacity to attend sessions.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site Required: Program-specific; Climate Tech example is virtual
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: Hybrid；存在必须/高价值线下节点，主要地点：Hong Kong / global。
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 硬件 / 机器人 / DeepTech；Climate / Energy；Crypto / Web3；阶段以 Pre-seed–seed 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司；缺少核心技术/IP、仅做轻量同质化应用或贸易型项目
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore: never show a single universal Brinc deal. Each vertical must be a child record before recommending exact money/equity.
